UN Rights Chief Urges Global Action on AI Risks

The United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights, Volker Turk, has called for urgent global coordination to mitigate the risks posed by artificial intelligence. In a letter sent to countries and AI developers on September 14, Turk warned that AI presents "unprecedented risks." He urged both governments and leading AI companies to take immediate action to regulate the technology. The call emphasizes the need for a unified international approach to address potential dangers associated with AI development and deployment.
